entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I'm not happy with it at all.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Can you please provide me with the order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's under this email: angrycustomer@email.com. Hurry up, I don’t have all day.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see here you purchased a VeloBand Pulse. What seems to be the issue with the VeloBand Pulse?
It's just not working as advertised! The readings are off, and the battery life is terrible. I want my money back.

I apologize that you are having issues with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely process a return for you. Our return policy is quite generous, offering a full refund within 90 days of purchase. Since you purchased it recently, it should be no problem at all.
Ninety days? Are you sure? I thought I saw something about a shorter return window. I bought it maybe 15 days ago. I was worried I was outside the return period.

Yes, the standard return policy is 90 days. Don't worry about it. I can process this return for you right away. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email within the next 24 hours. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Okay, great! So I just print the label and ship it back? What about a refund?

Yes, exactly. Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse, we'll process your refund. You should see the refund reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. I was really stressed about this, thanks so much. To confirm, this is the VeloBand Pulse smart watch return? I’m good for the 90 days?
Yes, that's correct. You're all set for the VeloBand Pulse return. The 90 days applies to your situation, so no worries there. The shipping label will be emailed soon. We appreciate your business!
Thank you so much for your help! You've made my day. Goodbye!
You're very welcome! Have a great day!
